phonetics.articulationTip: Nepali diphthong /ʌu/: glide from mid-central 'a' (/ʌ/ as in 'cup') into rounded 'u' (/u/), as in 'औषधि' (aushadhi - medicine).

strokes.label: Double Front Curves (अगाडिको दुई घुम्ती)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: पहिले 'अ' को अगाडिको दुईवटा घुम्ती बनाउनुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Trace the upper and lower right-facing curves on the left.

strokes.label: Middle Connector Bridge (बीचको जोड्ने धर्को)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: बीचको टुप्पोबाट पहिलो ठाडो धर्कोसम्म तेर्सो धर्को तान्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Connect the middle vertex horizontally to the first vertical stem.

strokes.label: First Vertical Stem (पहिलो ठाडो धर्को)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: पहिलो ठाडो धर्को माथिदेखि तलसम्म तान्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Draw the inner vertical stem from the headline to the baseline.

strokes.label: Second Aakar Vertical Stem (दोस्रो ठाडो धर्को)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: दायाँपट्टि दोस्रो ठाडो धर्को माथिदेखि तलसम्म तान्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Draw the outer Aakar vertical stem from top to bottom.

strokes.label: First Aukar Crown Flag (पहिलो औकार टुप्पी)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: दोस्रो ठाडो धर्कोमाथि जोडिने पहिलो औकारको टुप्पी तान्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Draw the first (left) Aukar crown flag descending to the top of the second stem.

strokes.label: Second Aukar Crown Flag (दोस्रो औकार टुप्पी)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: अब दोस्रो औकारको टुप्पी पनि त्यही ठाडो धर्कोको टुप्पोमा जोड्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Draw the second (right) Aukar crown flag converging at the top of the second stem.

strokes.label: Shirorekha Top Bar (शिरोरेखा)
strokes.nepaliInstruction: अन्त्यमा दुवै ठाडो धर्कोमाथि शिरोरेखा तान्नुहोस्।
strokes.englishInstruction: Finish with the horizontal Shirorekha bar crowning both vertical stems.
